skill.name: offer-claims-registry
skill.description: Maintain a canonical ledger for marketing claims, substantiation evidence, approved wording, disclaimers, and live offer terms. Use it to resolve source gaps in ads, briefs, landing pages, and comparison copy.
skill.summary: Maintains a substantiated ledger of marketing claims and live offers.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

remediation.suggestion: Copy required shared references into this skill, then replace ../../ links with local references under references/.

remediation.issue: Sibling skill links use filesystem paths outside this package.
remediation.suggestion: Name related skills without relative file paths, or use marketplace skill identifiers that do not require filesystem traversal.

content.value_statement: Marketing teams lose proof, approved wording, and offer dates across drafts and campaigns. This skill creates a shared ledger so agents can reuse claims without inventing evidence.
actual_capabilities: Extracts distinct marketing claims from pasted ads, briefs, landing pages, and comparison drafts.
Records evidence provenance as verified-document, user-attested, none-on-file, or expired.
Maintains claims-ledger.md with exact text, approved variants, disclaimers, usage, and review dates.
Maintains offers.md with terms, codes, dates, URLs, status, and linked claims.
Promotes live offers and unresolved claims into hot cache and open loops.
Answers exact claim, offer, and usage lookups without approving claims for launch.
limitations: It does not approve, score, or block marketing claims for shipping.
It cannot verify evidence unless the user names or provides a source.
It does not call ad platforms, ecommerce systems, or external APIs.
It requires clear claim text, offer terms, or candidate files to work well.

use_cases.title: Prepare paid ad claims
use_cases.description: Register claims and offers before ad builders pull approved wording and disclaimers.

use_cases.title: Resolve source gaps
use_cases.description: Turn needs-source flags from drafts into ledger rows with evidence status and review dates.

use_cases.title: Support compliance review
use_cases.description: Give reviewers a traceable record of claim wording, source provenance, and offer status.

prompt_templates.title: Register one claim
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with one claim and one evidence source.
prompt_templates.prompt: Register this claim: "Cuts reporting time by 40 percent." Evidence: Internal timing study, March 2026.

prompt_templates.title: Log current offers
prompt_templates.scenario: Create or update live offers before campaign launch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Log our current offers: SAVE50, 50 percent off annual plans, July 1 to July 31, landing page /summer.

prompt_templates.title: Sweep unresolved candidates
prompt_templates.scenario: Process claims collected by other skills.
prompt_templates.prompt: Sweep memory/claims/candidates.md and resolve all needs-source flags using the evidence notes I provided.

prompt_templates.title: Answer launch lookup
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether a claim has registered wording and source status.
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up this claim before launch: "Ships in 24 hours." Report provenance, approved wording, disclaimers, and open loops.

output_examples.input: Register a claim with a named study and a review date.
output_examples.output: Added a claim row with exact text, source name, user-provided evidence label, approved wording, usage, and next review date.

output_examples.input: Log a discount offer with code, dates, and landing page.
output_examples.output: Updated the offers table with live status, linked claim reference, offer terms, promo code, and end date.

output_examples.input: Sweep candidate claims from recent ad drafts.
output_examples.output: Merged duplicates, registered unsupported claims as none on file, and listed unresolved items for follow-up.

best_practices: Paste exact claim text, not a paraphrase.
Name the evidence source and date whenever possible.
Review expired offers before reusing related claims.
anti_patterns: Do not mark a claim as verified without user-provided evidence.
Do not use this skill to approve campaign launch decisions.
Do not store sponsorship disclosure formatting in claim disclaimers.

faq.question: Does this skill verify claims?
faq.answer: No. It records what evidence exists and labels the provenance.

faq.question: Can it approve an ad for launch?
faq.answer: No. Use an auditor or reviewer skill for launch decisions.

faq.question: What files does it maintain?
faq.answer: It maintains the claims ledger and live offers table under memory/claims.

faq.question: Can it work from pasted text?
faq.answer: Yes. Pasted copy, offer terms, and user-named sources are enough.

faq.question: How are unsupported claims handled?
faq.answer: They are registered as none-on-file and routed to open loops.

faq.question: Does it need API access?
faq.answer: No. It uses user-provided records and optional exports.
